Before the Queen had even got home to Reginapolis, repairs were already being done on the capital city. And as the Queen arrived home with what remained of her army, the Clanling settlers returned with what remained of themselves.

Many Clanling groups did not survive the Sentinels kidnapping spree. entire Clanling groups had just vanished into thin air. And those that did survive by hunkering down not only wasted their building supplies on the bunker, but also had barely survived themselves. Most surviving Clanling groups had less than 100 Fulcrid each. Those that returned to the capital did so because Reginapolis was the only place they thought they'd find life.

Once the groups returned, they were reorganized into new Clanling groups. But due to being short on supplies and settlers, only three Clanling groups of five-hundred were ready to go back out onto Gaea once more. And even then, some of the surviving Clanling were not reassigned to settling, but instead towards support. The remaining survivors were told to go off towards Texturaton and Aranea Portum with supplies, ready to continue construction on the two established cities.

Johbla's setting up of the West Gaean Trading Company was done to control the trade going in and out of the Dynasty's border. SeaFairer ships will start exporting goods towards Feather Harbour and the north path to the Deva, and will start importing and exporting from there. All of this, Johbla thought, would be the most logical first move.
